content.short: Okapi enables Web3 discovery through on-chain verified attestations, building transparent and verifiable reputation profiles for users on Mantle.
content.description: Okapi is a decentralized attestation platform enabling users and organizations to create, verify, and share on-chain credentials for building portable reputation profiles that prove activities, contributions, and achievements across the Web3 ecosystem. Deployed on Mantle and integrated with the network's developer infrastructure, Okapi enables credential-based applications where user trust and history can be verified on-chain without centralized identity providers.
